source.name: Footy Headlines: AEK Athens 26-27 Home Kit Released
source.quote: The Nike Swoosh is rendered in white on the right chest, opposite the official AEK FC crest on the left, with main sponsor Pame Stoixima placed centrally across the front.

source.name: Footy Headlines: AEK Athens 26-27 Home Kit Released
source.quote: AEK Athens and Nike have officially launched the club's new home kit for the 26-27 season.

summary: Pame Stoixima (OPAP) on the front and Nike as kit maker. Seajets, on the back since 2024-25, isn't listed: no source found names it on the 2026-27 shirt. Not complete: no source lists every placement on this shirt.
